Westcott Courses / UMass Global

Math, writing, science and health prerequisites delivered by Westcott, with university credit through UMass Global.

Build my degree plan

Choose a degree plan to see where specific courses fit.

Study format
Rolling enrollment and self-paced study. The statistics course requires at least four weeks; course-specific prerequisites and grading affect timing.
Pricing
Prices are per course. Examples: statistics $594 USD; College Reading and Composition $559 USD. Proctoring and some materials cost extra.
Assessments
Credit-bearing courses require a proctored final. The statistics course also requires recent qualifying intermediate algebra or higher coursework.
Credit type
Credit-bearing courses earn University of Massachusetts Global academic semester credit and an official university transcript. Noncredit versions are separate.
Transfer and enrollment details

How the credit works

Credit-bearing courses earn University of Massachusetts Global academic semester credit and an official university transcript. Noncredit versions are separate.

Before enrolling

  • Start with your degree plan to see the proposed receiving course or requirement.
  • Review any course-specific enrollment, equipment or assessment steps shown in your plan.
  • University decisions about your own records remain separate from published course matches.
